notes.title: DeV22
notes.content:
News from the lab:


Fix occupied vehicle at spawn
Fix vehicle spawner collision check
Fix character multiplayer adjustment
AVS update: drive train configurable for AWD, RWD and FWD
New vehicles: Delupo{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36433990/1190ace5c5940aa2afb0eed830bba9777c600d05.png , TmCanyon{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36433990/d594661758dd39911434c1d728a538f3ee0519dc.png
Solo races can be run. Currently without a timer or opponent.
Vehicle lights sync fix
Engine upgrade to UE5.4
Vehicles flash briefly when getting in and out
3 new POI in the city
Readme for new testers in the OS
Unstuck/Force Respawn in the Debug menu

notes.title: DeV.20
notes.content:
Here is a list of a few of the new changes. [/ b]
 
New features:

 There is now a button in the pause menu that leads to the GP support page.
 Revision of the new "AVS" vehicle system.
[/ list]
Fixed issues:

 The "Esc" key has been redesigned so that it closes the correct menus in a context-related manner without having to struggle with invisible mouse pointers.
[/ list]
Known problems:

 The graphics settings are not saved after restarting the game.
 The placement in the race is not shown.
 After a race on a dedicated map, the main menu does not come automatically.
 AVS vehicles sometimes have problems accepting gas.
 Multiplayer doesn't work yet.
If so, please report.
Thanks!
[/ list]

Have fun testing!

notes.title: DeV.19
notes.content:
Hello!

After a long break, the next update for Grand Prototype is finally here!
Since the last version was released quite a while ago, I only roughly know it was new.


AVS Test:
The "Advanced Vehecle System" will soon replace the current system and thus revise the vehicle physics. A map including a car are provided for testing.

Weapon test:
A map was modified to test the AI ​​and weapons.

Multiplayer
Multiplayer has been redesigned and should FINALLY work now ...

UI
Some UI elements have been revised.



You have to find the rest of the changes yourself.

Game On!

notes.title: DeV.17.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36433990/8344c3d2a87f157b70e8eb68a909d22750b3b363.png

 This update contains bug fixes and recurring features:
 
  Unsold plots can no longer be bought.
  Players and bots are displayed normally in cars again.
  Steering movements by players are displayed more gently.
  Players' hands and feet are correctly displayed on the pedals and steering wheel in vehicles.
  Fixed animations in the respawn screen.
  Edge climbing deactivated.
  Vehicle Decals reset.
  Players become ragdolls when run over
 [/ list]

 Until the next patch!

 Mineceater

notes.title: Update DeV.14
notes.content:
Due to internal structural changes from the DeV. 14 the saved vehicles from the previous versions are no longer displayed!

The update now includes vehicles with different engine values.

The main card is greener!
Plants are now on the map.

Vehicle shop has been revised!

Cities now have a UI welcome message.

Vehicle AI has received minor improvements.

New drift particles.
